summary: Periodically report unfinished profiled work with bounded metadata and retained logs.

replay.detail: No replay or projection behavior changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or digest rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Opt-in profiling adds in-flight.jsonl with bounded operation metadata and visible truncation; its current and one prior file are each capped at8 MiB.

manual.detail: No action is required. The existing ST3_PROFILE_DIR setting enables this additional diagnostic.

recovery.detail: No on-disk migration or recovery action.

downtime.detail: Normal binary restart; restart duration is not measured for this change.
